programmes.d: Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.
Jess Collins, a poor miner, helps Sonny chase off two men he calls claim jumpers. When he arrives in the nearby town, he learns Sonny is no good and everyone in town is against him.
An Arizona land-grabber (Telly Savalas) and his brother (George Maharis) renew their feud amid Army troops and Apaches.
A bounty hunter's need for vengeance emerges when he learns the outlaw he's escorting is related to his wife's killer.
A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) turns cowhand and then back again, fighting a cattle baron with two daughters (Barbara Britton, Dorothy Hart).
A wildcatter (Faye Dunaway), her father (John Mills) and a boozing drifter (George C. Scott) defend her oil derrick in 1913 Oklahoma.
War looms on the horizon when an Army officer's American Indian aide is accused of murdering a tribal elder.
A masked avenger (Charles Starrett) tries to help an innocent man (Jack Mahoney) accused of murder.

Returning from the war, Buck gets caught by Murdock, who takes his letter of introduction to the Del Reys. Posing as Buck, Murdock takes Del Ray's jewels and his daughter Jaunita. To rescue Juanita, Buck poses as Murdock.
The girlfriend (Evelyn Keyes) of a frontier doctor (Willard Parker) falls for a member (Larry Parks) of an outlaw clan.
The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).
Bat Masterson (George Montgomery), Doc Holliday (James Griffith) and Wyatt Earp rescue a framed rancher and stop an Indian war.
A cavalry officer and two of his men set out to make sure that a shipment of guns safely reaches its destination.
Three escaped convicts return to collect the money that the brother of one of them has already spent.
A Wyoming rancher's (Ernest Borgnine) wife eyes a drifter (Glenn Ford), and her ex-lover (Rod Steiger) tells her husband.
